note: Documented vendor facts that override what models.dev or OpenRouter report. Both of those are third-party aggregators, and both have been wrong. Every entry cites the vendor's own page. An entry whose upstream now agrees is dead weight and vendor_corrections_are_all_load_bearing fails until it is deleted.

corrections.reason: models.dev reports 1,000,000. Anthropic's context-windows page names the models that have a 1M window and then states that other Claude models, including Sonnet 4.5, have a 200K window. A too-large window is the dangerous direction: the overflow detector compacts at a fraction of it and the API rejects the oversized request instead.
The dated snapshot of the same model; same correction, same reason.

OpenRouter advertises context_length 1000000 for this route. #10159 removed this correction on the reasoning that OpenRouter sends the 1M-context beta header on its own account, so the route genuinely served 1M. That reasoning is wrong: Anthropic's context-windows page says "For every model with a 1M-token context window, 1M is the default: you don't need a beta header", and lists the 1M models by name without Sonnet 4.5, then says "Other Claude models, including Claude Sonnet 4.5, have a 200k-token context window". There is no beta path to 1M for this model, so no route can serve it. A 1M declaration lets a conversation grow past 200k input and the API returns 400 invalid_request_error, prompt is too long.
